project_description.value: Desarrollo Turístico Integral 'La Capilla': a 60.3-hectare tourism-residential development in Buena Vista, Santiago, Los Cabos. Divided into 11 planning zones. Components include: (1) Zona Hotelera with lodging, restaurants, commercial areas, spa, pools; (2) Multiple residential zones with single-family homes, apartment buildings, vertical condos; (3) Village zone: mixed-use with multifamily housing, retail, restaurants, public plazas, pedestrian walkways; (4) Casa Club and Beach Club for sports, dining, recreation, wellness; (5) Public beach access with balneario (bathrooms, showers, parking, palapas, recreational areas). Self-contained infrastructure: water, sewer, electricity networks, wastewater treatment plant, potential desalination plant. Located on predio Los Mártires, outside PDU San José-Cabo San Lucas 2040 polygon. UGA-T2 environmental zone allows tourism and human settlements under sustainability criteria.
project_description.method: HOY BCS detailed article + El Sudcaliforniano
project_description.evidence: Synthesized from both articles which provide detailed descriptions of 11 planning zones and components

research_inferences.value: (1) Consorcio de Ingeniería Integral is likely an engineering/construction firm — not a hotel developer, suggesting need for external hospitality partner; (2) Multiple residential typologies plus hotel suggest mixed-use branded development potential; (3) Beach Club and Casa Club components signal lifestyle/resort positioning; (4) Outside PDU 2040 — greenfield development in Buena Vista, East Cape's emerging corridor; (5) No SEMARNAT MIA filed yet — still very early in entitlements
